description: Sells unsubdivided residential lots in Kensington Phase 8.
Uses presale allocation process with open market sales.
Sets base price at $15,750 per front meter.
Applies architectural controls to sold properties.

chips.text: Eligible contractors and individuals can purchase lots.

description: City spent $875,743 on paper utility bills in 2024.
Council seeks incentives to boost e-bill adoption.

chips.text: Councillor Neill suggested making e-billing the default, potentially charging for paper bills.
Mayor Block asked about unintended consequences of making e-billing the default.
Potential impacts on seniors, disabled, and those without internet access were discussed.
Moving to e-billing would make the city more environmentally friendly.
Administration will report back on incentives to encourage e-bill adoption.
